page_title: The local configuration tool Mxc_Config is used to configure LAN device parameters
page_content:
#### Prerequisites:
- The device and computer are in the same LAN, and the computer can ping the local IP address of the device

#### Operation steps:
1. Click to download [MmxConfig_V1.0.10.rar](http://pug2.4000329988.comfqa/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=025cf1442dcea388ae2941e15105009f "[MmxConfig_V1.0.10.rar") configuration tool, unzip and install, click "Mxc_Config" to open the tool
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c578daf4102c0f11a7a530004641029c)
2. Click Search to search for devices in the LAN
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=545fb5ee726a12114c60424dbc3a83fc)
3. Select the device to view the configuration
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=93525305df96d01158e9bd3985ae3081)
4. On the left are some common function configuration items. After filling in the parameters, click the "set" button on the right to save the settings
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=58165b6a384d5a508dbdf8a971a8f2de)
5. On the right is the custom configuration command. Click to send
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4658c6e0621d85ddba71e1b6a4ee944f)
6. Get the feedback result after sending
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=0fc0490a7a3fc87d0d02f6baa4848734)
7. Click to clear the contents of the custom command window and response window below
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=6880341ee4318c6e26bafdad8bf873b2)
